disclaimer.title: Data Disclaimer
disclaimer.body_1: WT META Center is an independent community tool. Statistics are based on community-aggregated gameplay data. Vehicle characteristics and progression data are sourced from the publicly available War Thunder Datamine project using Sgambe33/WT-Vehicle-Data-Extract tool. Scores (META, FARM) are calculated estimates produced by custom statistical models — they are approximations, not ground truth.
disclaimer.body_2: Data may be outdated, incomplete, or statistically biased due to sample size, game patches, or collection methodology. Use this tool for reference and entertainment purposes only.
disclaimer.legal: This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Gaijin Entertainment in any way.'War Thunder' is a trademark of Gaijin Entertainment. By continuing, you accept that all information is provided 'as-is' without any warranty.
disclaimer.note: This notice is shown once. You can revisit the source code at any time.

home_tab.subtitle: War Thunder analytics and statistics — all in one place.
home_tab.desc_meta: Full performance ranking of all vehicles — META score, K/D, and win rate, filterable by BR, mode, and class.
home_tab.desc_brackets: Weighted META score per nation across every BR bracket. See who dominates each tier.
home_tab.desc_farm: Build the most efficient SL farming lineup for any BR. Find the best earners and hidden gems.
home_tab.desc_progression: Tech tree verdicts for every vehicle: must-grind, skip, lineup filler, or premium fix.
home_tab.desc_cost: Compare total RP and SL cost to fully unlock each nation's tech tree, broken down by rank.
home_tab.desc_history: Browse all vehicles grouped by the game update they were introduced in.

about.title: About WT META Center
about.project_desc: WT META Center — an independent community tool for analyzing War Thunder statistics. It provides META rankings, farm efficiency analysis, tech tree costs, and progression information based on real gameplay data.
about.data_vdb: Vehicle technical data from War Thunder Datamine (Sgambe33/WT-Vehicle-Data-Extract)
about.data_scores: META and FARM scores — these are statistical model estimates — not official data
